description: Extract text and tables from a Word .docx file ($0.005 USDC via x402). Input: a public https url to a .docx, or docx_base64. https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 10 MB file, ~15s timeout, max 5 redirects. Tables appear as [table N] placeholders in text. Unicode dashes/minus signs normalized to '-'. Old binary .doc files are not supported. Returns JSON { file, url, final_url, type: 'docx', text, tables: [{ rows }], warnings }. As is, no warranty. Nothing stored.

docx_base64.description: Alternative to url: the .docx bytes, base64-encoded (max 10 MB).

filename.description: Optional file name echoed back as `file`.

url.description: https URL of a .docx file. http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected.

name: docx-to-text
